title: Zero third-party dependencies — MCP JSON-RPC, CSV and the query engine are all pure stdlib
evidence: go.mod has no require block (module brsoccer; go 1.26.6); no go.sum present; mcp/server.go hand-rolls JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio with bufio/encoding/json
suggestion: None — keeps the build hermetic and fast; noted as a positive for cross-run comparison

title: Implementation substantially exceeds the required 12 capabilities
evidence: soccer/queries.go adds Derbies (traditional rivalries), LibertadoresBracket, relegation marking in Standings, ClubSummary, position-group filtering and multi-file match de-duplication (soccer/data.go:199 add)
suggestion: None — surfaced as beyond-spec work, not a deduction

title: Dense multi-condition expressions rely on Go operator precedence without grouping parens
evidence: soccer/queries.go:108 `if season != 0 && m.Season != season || !CompetitionMatches(...)` and :111, :117 pack several && / || terms on one line; maintainability=0.606, idiomatic=0.65 from scores.json
suggestion: Add parentheses around the AND-groups or split into named booleans to make the filter logic self-evident
